changelog: New for Pro: Liquid glass. Clear glass that shows your screen through the notch and bends it at the edges.
New: Theme on the closed notch. Your material and effects can now show on the closed notch too.
New: Date beside the clock. Choose Day, Date or Off in Settings, General.
The button in the open notch's top-right corner now shows a power icon, so it is clear it quits Smart Notch.
Alt+F4 or Ctrl+W pressed while the notch has focus no longer closes it.
Double-clicking the slim line brings the notch back every time.
Choosing Notch, Pill or Bar now leaves slim-line mode, so the new style shows straight away.
Fullscreen music: a song without lyrics now brings the cover to the centre smoothly and says there are no lyrics, instead of looking stuck.

highlight.title: Meet Liquid glass
highlight.text: A clear glass notch for Pro: it shows your screen through the notch and bends it at the edges, with no tint and no blur.
